rows.value: COW codes Chile's sustained-combat episode in War of the Pacific as began on 1879-02-14.
rows.locator: Original CSV row69; WarNum=64; ccode=155; Side=1; StartYear/Month/Day1
qualifications: COW-coded date on which sustained combat began for this participant; academic coding, not an asserted legal declaration or war-wide beginning. Source endpoint coding concerns sustained combat or threshold-related last engagement; end day may be the day after last major engagement. No war-wide cessation or declaration inferred.
Actual event date is unchanged. Relevance in a later snapshot is explicitly past dated context within five calendar years, not an assertion of ongoing war or a retimed event.
